rationale: Docs-truth lens, sampled hard: verified 25+ specific claims across the 12 domain-doc files against the landed code at 66be65a7, spanning all three domains. Every sampled function name, signature, constant, and behavior description checked out except two line-number citations in core architecture.md (detailed in findings). Verified exact-match samples include: (core) WithPhaseWriteLock's full signature incl. fn's (stored, present) shape (phaselock.go:239), PhaseLockRelPath/ErrPhaseLockTimeout/DescribeLockFailure(err, recoveryCommand)/SetLockWaitForTest(wait, poll) and the 10s bounded wait (phaselock.go:65); IsBackwardMove's incomparable-pairs-report-backward semantics (order.go:39-46); SanctionedDerivedSync's lock-internal error-propagating children read (sanctioned_sync.go:52-66) with releaseSyncPhase (cmd/mindspec/release.go:162/167) as sole production caller; LegacyPhaseSignature(stored, []ChildInfo)/EnsurePhaseSemanticsV2 -> (bool, error) + both marker constants; DerivePhaseWithStatus(epicID, epicStatus)'s direction-conditional warnings — backward gets bd-show-only, forward gets repair-phase, legacy signature gets the 'legacy phase semantics detected' notice (derive.go:200-236); ModeIndeterminate excluded from ValidModes (state.go:30-33); all eight claimed writer sites really route through the lock (spec.go:203, plan.go:513, impl.go:587/630, adopt.go:428, complete.go:1334, repair.go:254, migrate.go:88, release via sanctioned sync) and writer_inventory_test.go + the AC-5(vii) contention test exist. (execution) All eight Executor methods with exact signatures (executor.go:220-293); MindspecStageTrailerKey/StageMaterialization/StageArtifactSync and the refs/mindspec/materialized marker ref (materialize.go); wrapBDError + bdStderrExcerptLineCap=20 (bdcli.go:452/483); RuntimeIgnoreEntries/sandbox/bootstrap all carry .mindspec/phase.lock; FileExistsAtRef (gitops.go:157) and HasGitignoreEntry (gitops.go:688); both harness scenarios exist. (workflow) IsDraftSpecWithCache/ResolveSpecPrefixProven/draftSpecStatusWithCache; handleIdleOrDraft/handleDraft/handleIndeterminate + BuildIndeterminateContext(WithCache)/RenderIndeterminate with the claimed completeTail (cmd/mindspec/complete.go:170) and emitInstruct (instruct_tail.go:96) callers; completeFetchChildrenFn seam + Result.NextModeIndeterminate/IndeterminateReason (complete.go:48-55/316-324/1270); stateDiscoveryFailure (state.go:47); hook fail-closed on ModeIndeterminate (dispatch.go:125); ComputeEntangleablePaths/CheckDirtyTreeProportional's exact (blockingDirt, ignoredDirt, err) return; ReadySet{Filtered,Raw,SpecFlag} + ExcludedCount/ExclusionNotice/BuildReadySet/scopeResolutionRefusal; SelectWork's total pick semantics exactly as documented (select.go:23-38: 0=default, negative errors, pick>=1 always indexes even a single-item list); SelectNamedFromReadySet's exclusion-reason behavior; newExecutorFn (root.go:36) and mutatingVerbRows/mutatingVerbAliases/nonMutatingAllowlist with the 'nine verbs' count (verb_output_test.go:89-125); nextPhaseMergeMetadataFn genuinely at next.go:608 (the doc hedges 'line ~608' — accurate); ValidateDocsSnapshot(root, base, treeOID, wtPath, exec) exact; CheckADRDivergenceSnapshot forcing ownerRef==treeOID confirmed by adr_divergence.go:84-97; panel/gate.go's refusal wording really was updated to name commit-tree-built commits (gate.go:291-292); FormatResult's plan-mode message really dropped the false 'blocked' claim. The AC-12 template test genuinely derives the invocation from adoptCmd.CommandPath() and Flags().Lookup("reason") on the registered command — a rename or flag-rename goes red — and idle.md/review.md carry the exact 'mindspec impl adopt <spec-id> --reason' invocation. merge-safety.md's gate-refusal section is correctly scoped to doc-sync/ADR-divergence refusals with post-gate failures explicitly carved out to spec 127 territory. The one defect found is two wrong line-number citations, a minor prose fix that does not undermine the sweep's substance.
concrete_changes_required: MINOR (docs-truth, .mindspec/domains/core/architecture.md, phase-write-lock section): two hard line-number citations are wrong at the reviewed commit. (1) 'spec approve's existing-epic backfill (internal/approve/spec.go:76)' — line 76 is the spec-frontmatter approval step; the backfill call is at spec.go:91 and backfillExistingEpicPhase's locked write at spec.go:202-203. (2) 'plan approve (plan.go:455)' — the locked write is at internal/approve/plan.go:513; line 455 lands inside a pre-existing comment block whose adjacent text still describes the pre-v2 'flips mindspec_phase to implement' behavior, so the wrong citation actively points a reader at prose contradicting the doc's own (correct) v2 claim. Fix: correct both to the real locations or drop the :NN suffixes in favor of the function names (backfillExistingEpicPhase; the Step-4b WithPhaseWriteLock write), which are stable. Every other file/function attribution in the section verified correct.

findings.claim: Writer-inventory prose cites internal/approve/spec.go:76 and plan.go:455 as the spec-approve backfill and plan-approve write sites
findings.evidence: At 66be65a7 the backfill is invoked at internal/approve/spec.go:91 with the locked write in backfillExistingEpicPhase at spec.go:202-203; the plan-approve locked write is at internal/approve/plan.go:513. plan.go:454-455 is a stale pre-v2 comment ('flips the epic's mindspec_phase to implement') — the citation points readers at text contradicting the doc's correct claim that plan approve now writes plan.
findings.disposition: Fix the two citations (or replace with function names); no behavior claim in the section is wrong.

findings.claim: Pre-existing code comment at plan.go:454 still describes the retired pre-v2 semantics ('Step 4b flips the epic's mindspec_phase to implement')
findings.evidence: The actual Step 4b write at plan.go:513-517 writes state.ModePlan with a backward-move no-op guard, per OQ-3 v2 semantics. The stale comment predates this bead (not in the bead-10 diff) so it is out of this docs-sweep's scope, but worth a follow-up sweep since the new architecture.md citation lands next to it.
findings.disposition: Out of bead-10 scope; flag for a follow-up comment fix in workflow-domain code.
